scope: All git-changed and untracked nonignored files, including docs and generated installer; local env filenames only in repository walk excluding dependency/build/git directories.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and assignment-heuristic scan only; not a proof that all conceivable secret formats are absent. Values and source snippets are never emitted.

whitespace.rawLogPolicy: Reported separately; evidence logs were not altered to remove preserved command output.

historicalMigrations.classification048057: UNCHANGED; prior irreproducible proof classification retained, no new execution or investigation.

limitations: Read-only source audit; no runtime, database, hosted, provider or capacity certification.
Concurrent parent documentation/evidence writes, if any, are enumerated explicitly by source drift fields.

preservedChecks: service role and exact resource request
exact deployment commit and authority epoch
committed provider origin and matching retained fence evidence
normal ingress or existing worker-only rollback drain
maintenance-capability claims denied for provider mode
annual capability denied without lawful certificate
focusedSourceBodyReview.compilerPinClassification: Exact hash-pinned original069 schema scaffold; synthetic compiler facts are explicitly not historical authority proof.
focusedSourceBodyReview.providerEvidenceClaim: Checkpoint-based final-source revalidation; explicitly not a complete uninterrupted final069 reinstallation.
focusedSourceBodyReview.limitation: Bounded source/body review and consistency with retained focused evidence; no additional database or hosted execution.
